C13.name: ACCELERATION_REIGNITION
C13.hypothesis: A current leader continues when trigger-minute price acceleration and taker-buy share rise together, and the most recent 5m contribution dominates the preceding 10m.
C13.structure: four completed 1m bars ending at trigger; positive accelerating last return; nondecreasing buyer share with >=8pp improvement and final >=55%; 5m return exceeds half of prior 10m contribution

C14.name: COMPRESSION_EXPANSION
C14.hypothesis: A leader is safer after a compact shelf and buyer-led range expansion than after an undifferentiated pullback trigger.
C14.structure: four-minute shelf width <=0.8%; trigger range >=1.5x shelf mean; close breaks shelf high, buyer share >=60%, close in top quartile

C15.name: RANK_PERSISTENCE_LEADER
C15.hypothesis: Persistent cross-sectional leadership with current 30m contribution is superior to a one-snapshot 24h return rank.
C15.structure: top-10 eligible at least two of current/prior two 15m snapshots; current rank not worse by >3; return30m positive and >=55% of positive return60m
